name: [2 DAYS] Crazy Skeleton RNG
desc:
JOIN THE GROUP FOR AN EXTRA LUCK BOOST!

Play the game on weekends to earn a 2x runtime luck bonus!
Like and support the game so we have more motivation to do updates!

Not your average "RNG" game.
Collect Sanses that spawn throughout the map randomly every second.
By clicking on it or using weapons at your disposal.
Contribution will determine your worthiness of collecting a Sans.

With more difficult Sanses being rarer, may your luck treat you well in this world.

Developed by @Laserberg, @BludnMonsters, @Saha000412 and @8_0662233
Additional help from @sindisaoa, @HeavensentThesis and @BadCreePer98
Sans models by @sarberlool
Arts by @TomMogsU and @botakmenhilang30
Maps by @arturklng and @SharkBlue_Chris
Official CSR OST by @echo2z3
